python3 << 'EOF'
from openpyxl import load_workbook
wb = load_workbook('budget.xlsx')
ws = wb['Budget']

# Extract data ranges the formulas reference
income = [ws.cell(row=r, column=2).value for r in range(4, 8)]   # B4:B7
expenses = [ws.cell(row=r, column=3).value for r in range(11, 23)]  # C11:C22

total_income = sum(income)
total_expenses = sum(expenses)
balance = total_income - total_expenses

print('Income items:', income)
print('Total Income (B8)   =', total_income)
print('Expense items:', expenses)
print('Total Expenses (C23)=', total_expenses)
print('Balance (B25)       =', balance)
print()
print('Formulas in file:')
print('  B8  =', ws['B8'].value)
print('  C23 =', ws['C23'].value)
print('  B25 =', ws['B25'].value)
EOF
